Warm stone complex retains both courtyard openings, stepped shaft, ornamental crowns and green spire. Inset masonry necks connect the upper stages; clock dials project beyond facade windows and dark hands remain legible.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all27 final lighting, level and transition frames. Every level retains the full low complex, both courtyard holes, rounded Congress Hall and clock tower. Far levels simplify perimeter contours and merge facade/crown details; street and closeup restore window impressions, individual merlons and clock hands. Geographic staging is flat; PMTiles contact correction and synthetic neighboring buildings are approximate context.
